trigger: Bank list page 2 carries audit-bank-20 into the COD list request.

baselineObserved.detail: Cursor không còn phù hợp. Mở lại đầu danh sách.

sourceFindings: ReconciliationPage called useListQuery() for the bank, COD, reconciliation-case and debt operations; the helper read the same URL key cursor for each operation.
The COD match dialog populated bank choices from the currently paged bank list.
The reconciliation dialog populated debt choices from the currently paged debt list and searched the current bank page for transaction details.
expectedUi: A page cursor is sent only to the collection that owns it; tab switching and browser Back do not send an invalid cursor.
COD matching can page through bank choices independently of the bank table page.
Case matching resolves its transaction by ID and pages debt choices independently of list-table state.
Lookup loading and errors use the shared QueryState behavior.
architectureInvariants: Use typed operations and existing useApi/usePagedApi hooks; preserve shop, principal and permission query-key scope.
Use only contract-defined request fields and keep URL cursors distinct per collection.
Do not add cross-module imports or direct fetch calls.
notes: C01 is baseline acceptance only; it does not claim the new implementation or current FE gates pass.
